🎓 *¿Quieres sacarte el título?* → *cursos PADI*: Open Water (el básico), Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades.

msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Great plan! Completing your PADI Open Water with a refresher is a smart way to feel confident in the water.

For the 2-day Open Water Referral Course departing from Cartagena, the online price is 474 USD per person. This includes 4 certification dives, equipment, boat transfers, lunch on day 1, and more.

The Dive Mini Course (refresher) is a one-day introduction with pool practice and 1 ocean dive, no prior certification needed, priced at 183 USD online per person.

Since you want both for 2 persons, you would multiply each price by 2. Remember, the mini course does not certify but is a great refresher.

Would you like me to send you the booking links to continue with these two services?

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Perfect! For the best convenience, I recommend staying at either Hotel San Pedro de Majagua or Hotel Cocoliso on Isla Grande. Our dive base is located at these two hotels, so pick-up for diving is direct from there.

Other good options with maritime access where we can also coordinate pick-up include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao.

Accommodation is not included in the diving plans, so you book directly with the hotel. Staying at one of these will make your diving days easier and more relaxed.

Would you like me to help you with any other details while you decide your days?

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en
